objective: Trace the complete batch8 workload on both physical DCUs throughout R01-R10; runtime stages remain serial but every measured workload preserves DP2.

serial_semantics.adapt_goals: A01-A11 execute serially and only migrate text/code.
serial_semantics.runtime_goals: R01-R10 execute serially in one fresh lineage.
serial_semantics.within_runtime_goal: Every model execution and capture uses the full DP2 topology on physical DCUs 0 and 1; serial runtime ordering must never be implemented by reducing the workload to one device.
serial_semantics.profiler: Preserve rank and native physical-device identity for both DP workers. If a profiler pass must be split per device or counter family, all pieces remain attributes of the same dual-card batch8 contract and both devices must reach the stage coverage gate.

workload_profile_reuse.allowed: Reuse process definitions, taxonomy, marker vocabulary, schemas, and reconstruction method as migration inputs.
workload_profile_reuse.forbidden: Do not reuse prior single-card timings, traces, device mappings, runtime handoffs, or measurement evidence; regenerate all R01-R10 evidence for this profile.
